responsibility: Declares and organizes the reusable platform base-spec modules that provide shared TargetOptions building blocks for concrete target definitions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `spec/mod.rs`, which owns the full target-spec system, and `spec/base/apple/mod.rs`, which implements one family-specific builder, this `mod.rs` is just the catalog of reusable base-spec modules that concrete targets compose from.
